					 Eligibility Criteria for M.Tech Admission 
							 
			 
			 
		 

						 
				 
		 
					 
				 
				 
									 Eligibility Criteria for M.Tech Admission 
Candidates seeking admission to the Master of Technology (M.Tech) program at Bansal Institute of Science and Technology, Bhopal, must fulfill the following eligibility criteria as per the guidelines of the Directorate of Technical Education (DTE), Madhya Pradesh:
 
 	 Educational Qualification: 
 
 	 The candidate must have completed a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering/Technology (B.E./B.Tech) or an equivalent degree in a relevant branch from a recognized university or institution. 
 	 Candidates with an M.Sc./MCA degree in related disciplines (where applicable) may also be eligible, subject to university norms. 
 
 
 	 Minimum Marks Required: 
 
 	 Candidates must have obtained at least 50% marks (45% for SC/ST/OBC candidates of Madhya Pradesh) in the qualifying degree examination. 
 
 
 	 Entrance Examination: 
 
 	 Admission is primarily through GATE (Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering). 
 	 Candidates without GATE scores may be considered for institute-level counseling or non-GATE seats, based on merit or entrance tests conducted by the institution. 
 
 
 	 Domicile Requirement (for State Quota): 
 
 	 
 For admission under the state quota, the candidate should be a domicile of Madhya Pradesh or must have completed their qualifying degree from an institute located in Madhya Pradesh. 
 
 
 
 	 Reservation Policy: 
 
 	 Reservation for SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PWD/Female candidates will be applicable as per the Government of Madhya Pradesh guidelines. 
 
 
 								 
				 
					 
				 
				 
					 
						 
				 
					 Eligibility Criteria for MCA Admission 
							 
			 
			 
		 

						 
				 
		 
					 
				 
				 
									 Candidates seeking admission to the Master of Computer Applications (MCA) program at Bansal Institute of Science and Technology, Bhopal must fulfill the following eligibility criteria as per the guidelines of the Directorate of Technical Education (DTE), Madhya Pradesh: Educational Qualification: The applicant must have a Bachelor’s degree of at least 3 years duration in any discipline from a recognized university. The candidate must have studied Mathematics at 10+2 level or at the graduation level. Minimum Percentage Requirement: A minimum of 50% marks in the qualifying degree is required for candidates belonging to the General category. A relaxation of 5% is applicable for candidates belonging to the SC/ST/OBC categories of Madhya Pradesh, i.e., 45% marks. Entrance Test / Admission Basis: Admission to the MCA program is conducted through online counseling by DTE, Madhya Pradesh, based on merit in the qualifying examination or performance in state-level entrance tests, if conducted. Non-entrance based admissions may be considered for vacant seats as per norms. Domicile Requirement (for State Quota Seats): For admission under the State Quota, the candidate must be a domicile of Madhya Pradesh or must have passed the qualifying examination from an institution located in Madhya Pradesh. Reservation Policy: Reservation for SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PWD candidates is applicable as per the rules of the Government of Madhya Pradesh. 								 
				 
					 
				 
				 
					 
						 
				 
					 Eligibility Criteria for MBA Admission 
							 
			 
			 
		 

						 
				 
					 
		 
				 
				 
									 Candidates seeking admission to the Master of Business Administration (MBA) program at Bansal Institute of Science and Technology, Bhopal must meet the following eligibility criteria as per the norms of Barkatullah University and Directorate of Technical Education (DTE), Madhya Pradesh: Educational Qualification: The candidate must possess a Bachelor’s degree of minimum 3 years duration in any discipline from a recognized university or institution. Minimum Percentage Requirement: General Category: A minimum of 50% marks in the qualifying degree examination. Reserved Categories (SC/ST/OBC of Madhya Pradesh): A minimum of 45% marks. Entrance Examination: Admission is primarily through CMAT (Common Management Admission Test) conducted by NTA, followed by online counseling by DTE, Madhya Pradesh. Candidates who have not appeared for CMAT may also be considered for admission under college-level counseling for vacant seats, based on merit. Domicile Requirement (for State Quota): Candidates applying under the State Quota must be domicile of Madhya Pradesh or must have completed their graduation from a recognized institute in Madhya Pradesh. Reservation Policy: The reservation of seats will be as per the norms prescribed by the Government of Madhya Pradesh, including provisions for SC, ST, OBC, EWS, PwD, and Female candidates.

    Overview

    1371:The Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE) is committed to excellence in teaching, research, and innovation. It offers B.Tech. programme with intake of 30 & M.Tech (Digital Communication) with intake of 18. We provide the robust curriculum covering core areas such as electronic circuits, communication systems, embedded systems, VLSI, and signal processing. The department is equipped with state-of-the-art laboratories and modern infrastructure to support hands-on learning and research. With a team of highly qualified faculty, it fosters academic excellence, industry collaboration, and student-centered learning. The department regularly organizes workshops, seminars, and industrial training to enhance practical skills. Graduates are well-prepared for careers in industry, higher studies, and entrepreneurship in the field of electronics and communication. 1379:

    NATIONAL SCIENCE DAY 2026

    Bansal Institute of Science and Technology, Kokta Anand Nagar, Bhopal, celebrated National Science Day 2026 on 27–28 February with great enthusiasm, supported by the M.P. Council of Science and Technology (MPCST), Bhopal. The two-day event aimed to promote scientific awareness, innovation, and curiosity among students through a variety of activities, including scientist interaction sessions, expert talks, poster making, extempore, quiz, and project exhibitions. Distinguished speakers shared insights on emerging scientific trends, inspiring students toward research and innovation. A total of 450 students participated, including 151 girls, making the event vibrant and inclusive. The celebration concluded with a valedictory function and prize distribution, marking the success of the program.


    FDP on Effective Research Paper Writing: From Idea to Publication

    The Department successfully organized a Five-Day Faculty Development Programme (FDP) on the theme “Effective Research Paper Writing: From Idea to Publication” to strengthen the research and publication skills of faculty members and research scholars. The programme provided comprehensive insights into research writing, manuscript preparation, publication ethics, journal selection, peer-review processes, emerging research trends, and funding opportunities. Expert sessions were delivered by distinguished academicians and researchers including Dr. Sandeep Singhai, Dr. Gaurav Dwivedi, Dr. Tikendra Nath Verma from MANIT Bhopal, Dr. Manoj Kumar Gupta from CSIR–AMPRI, and Dr. Anoop Pratap Singh. Participants gained valuable knowledge on identifying research gaps, improving manuscript quality, handling reviewers’ feedback, avoiding plagiarism, enhancing global research visibility, and exploring interdisciplinary collaborations. The FDP concluded with a valedictory session emphasizing future directions in research and academic excellence, inspiring participants to pursue high-quality, impactful, and ethical research practices.

    Faculty Development Programme (FDP): The Faculty Development Program (FDP) enhanced teaching skills and subject knowledge through expert lectures, interactive sessions, and hands-on training. It fostered innovation, research aptitude, and collaboration among faculty. The initiative empowered participants with essential knowledge to identify, prevent, and respond to cyber threats effectively, promoting responsible digital citizenship among students.

    1365:

    Welcome to the vibrant world of Electrical and Electronics Engineering! At our department, we are driven by a clear and compelling mission: to provide a high-quality education that equips our students with the skills and knowledge they need to become innovative designers and problem solvers in both the public and private sectors.

    Our B.Tech. program in Electrical and Electronics Engineering is tailored to empower students with cutting-edge expertise and practical solutions. Our faculty members are the heart and soul of this dynamic environment, holding esteemed degrees from prestigious institutions, including B. Tech, M. Tech, and PhD qualifications.

    Within the department, our faculty members specialize in diverse fields of Electrical Engineering, including Power Systems, Electrical Machines, Electrical Drives, High Voltage Engineering, Control Systems, Instrumentation, Signal Processing, and Data Mining. Their expertise extends beyond the classroom, as they have been prolific contributors to renowned International Journals and Proceedings of various International and National Seminars, Conferences, Symposia, and Workshops.

    Furthermore, our dedicated faculty members have also contributed chapters to books published by well-known international publishers, showcasing their commitment to advancing knowledge and research in the field.

    IoT Controlled Charger for Electric Vehicle / Dr. Anwar Ahamed Ansari

    Dr. Anwar Ahamed Ansari, a professor of the Electrical and Electronics Engineering Department at Bansal Institute of Science Technology in Bhopal, has published a patent titled “IoT Controlled Charger for Electric Vehicle” with application number 379558-001. The innovative technology allows for remote charging control of electric vehicles through an Internet of Things (IoT) platform.

    Smart Grounding Grid for Surge Protection / Professor Laxman Solankee

    Professor Laxman Solankee from Bansal Institute of Science Technology in Bhopal has been published a patent (Application number 383132-001) for his invention called “Smart Grounding Grid for Surge Protection”. The new and improved grounding system uses advanced sensors and monitoring devices to provide effective protection against power surges and lightning strikes. The invention is considered to be a significant advancement in the field of electrical engineering, with potential widespread applications in the power and electrical industries.

    1362:

    Welcome to the Department of Mechanical Engineering at Bansal Institute of Science and Technology, Bhopal. Our journey began in the year 2000. Throughout these years, we have grown our expertise and competence towards core knowledge, skill development and research. 

    Mechanical Engineering includes versatile fields like energy, fluid dynamics, dynamics, combustion, vibrations, design, manufacturing methods, systems modeling and simulation, mechatronics, robotics, material mechanics, rapid prototyping, and composites. It addresses every facet of transforming thermal energy into valuable work and the devices that enable this process. Mechanical engineering is commonly known as the ‘parent’ of all engineering disciplines. A captivating aspect of mechanical engineering is that the scope of applications in this discipline is remarkably wide and varied. If you find yourself curious about the workings of things, captivated by robots and car engines, then mechanical engineering could be the career for you.

    Mechanical Engineering department in Bansal Institutes of Science and Technology, Bhopal provides an engineering curriculum grounded in science. The main emphasis of our curriculum is to provide students with technical expertise and enhance their ability to solve problems and innovate new technologies.

    We provide a B. Tech program for undergraduates and an M. Tech program in Industrial Engineering and Management for postgraduates. The current enrollment is 30 for UG Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) and 30 students for PG Master of Engineering (M.Tech.) in Industrial Engineering, respectively.

    Our department boasts an impressive track record in teaching and research. Faculty members possess outstanding academic qualifications and are widely esteemed. The Faculty members have shared their research results in diverse international and national journals, conferences, and seminars.

    At BIST, we concentrate on delivering a solid theoretical foundation along with valuable practical experience to students in applicable fields. The goal is to offer a contemporary, industry-focused education in the Mechanical Engineering Department. Its goal is to create qualified professionals capable of effectively addressing the needs of the Industry while also emphasizing the cultivation of responsible citizens who will contribute to the progress of the Nation and Society

    Industrial Visit at LM Bakers PVT. LTD. Madideep

    The Department of Mechanical Engineering, Bansal Institute of Science & Technology (BIST), Bhopal organized an Industrial Visit to LM Bakers Private Limited, Mandideep, on 06th July 2026 for the students of IV Semester Mechanical Engineering. The visit was planned as a part of the department’s continuous efforts to bridge the gap between classroom learning and industrial practices by providing students with practical exposure to modern manufacturing systems and industrial operations.

    The primary objective of the visit was to familiarize students with industrial food manufacturing processes, automated production systems, quality assurance practices, maintenance strategies, and hygiene standards followed in a large-scale food processing industry. The visit also aimed to enhance students’ understanding of the application of mechanical engineering concepts in food production, packaging, utility management, and industrial safety.

    Project Exhibition Competition

    The students of the Department of Mechanical Engineering actively participated in the state-level Project Exhibition “Technovision 2026” held on 08th May 2026 at Madhyanchal Professional University, Bhopal. The event provided an excellent platform for students to showcase their innovative ideas, technical skills, and problem-solving abilities through various engineering projects. The Mechanical Engineering students presented their project with great enthusiasm and demonstrated their creativity, design capabilities, and practical knowledge. Their remarkable performance was appreciated by the jury members and participants. The team secured the Second Prize in the exhibition, bringing pride and recognition to the department. This achievement reflects the dedication and innovative spirit of the students.

    Attended Workshop on “Accelerating the Sustainable Development Goal”

    Students from the Department of Mechanical Engineering actively participated in the five-day Workshop on “Sustainable Development Goals and Research Symposium”, held from 18th to 22nd May 2026 at MANIT Bhopal. The workshop provided students with valuable exposure to sustainable development practices, innovative research methodologies, and emerging technological solutions. Their participation enhanced their knowledge, research aptitude, and awareness of the role of engineering in addressing global sustainability challenges.

    Crompton Greaves Power Mandideep, Bhopal

    The department organised an industrial visit to Crompton Greaves Power Mandideep, Bhopal. The students visited the manufacturing and production sector and experienced the real-time approach in manufacturing industries. They also meet the industry persons at CG Power and take valuable suggestions to foster their knowledge.

    Central Farm Machinery Training & Testing Institute

    An Industrial Visit was conducted on 06/11/2025 for 3rd and 5th semester students from the Department of Mechanical Engineering to “Central Farm Machinery Training & Testing Institute” (CFMTTI), Budni (M.P.). During the visit, students gained valuable exposure to the testing and evaluation of farm machinery, tractor performance analysis, and modern mechanisation techniques adopted in Indian agriculture. The officials at CFMTTI briefed the students about the institute’s role under the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, various testing facilities, training programmes, and the importance of safety and performance standards in agricultural equipment.

    Industrial Insight at Sant Shiromani Ravidas Global Skills Park

    The Department of Mechanical Engineering organized an industrial visit to Sant Shiromani Ravidas Global Skills Park (SSRGSP) for IV semester students. As India’s first multi-skills park, SSRGSP houses COSA and CAAT, offering exposure to advanced training and entrepreneurship development. Trainers demonstrated the operation and applications of Industry 3.0 machines, enriching students’ understanding of modern industrial practices and skill-based education.

    BIST Students Explore Advanced Manufacturing at Smart Automation

    On 30/11/2024, 3rd-semester Mechanical Engineering students, accompanied by faculty, visited Smart Automation, Govindpura. They observed conventional and automated manufacturing processes for mechanical components and explored key departments like Safety, Metal Casting, and Inspection. The visit provided valuable practical insights, bridging theoretical knowledge with real-world applications, while showcasing the facility’s precision, innovation, and exceptional standards in engineering excellence.

    Welspun Corporation Ltd.

    On 14/09/24, 3rd-semester Mechanical Engineering students visited Welspun Corporation Ltd., observing the production of 143-inch diameter pipes. They explored Safety, Metal Forming, and Inspection departments, gaining practical insights and bridging theory with real-world applications. The visit showcased Welspun’s precision, innovation, and global manufacturing excellence.

    Mechanical Engineering Students Tour MSME Ministry

    On June 17, 2024, VI semester students from the Department of Mechanical Engineering visited the Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (MSME) and the Government of India. The visit offered students a comprehensive exploration of the latest advancements in manufacturing technologies and the evolving needs of the industry. The students were introduced to various recent technologies and improvements in machinery through detailed briefings by the trainers. This exposure provided valuable insights into the state-of-the-art equipment and innovations available at MSME training centres, enhancing their understanding of current industrial practices and preparing them for future career challenges.

    Bansal Extraction & Export Pvt. Ltd.

    The III Semester Students of the Mechanical Engineering Department at BIST Bhopal recently embarked on an enriching industrial visit to Bansal Extraction & Export Pvt. Ltd. This immersive experience provided them with firsthand exposure to the fascinating world of soybean oil extraction and advanced industrial processes. The visit commenced with a tour of the boiler section, where they witnessed the essential steam generation process that fuels the operations. Moving on to the refinery section, the students were captivated by the intricate machinery employed in transforming soybeans into edible oil. They observed various advanced machining processes, gaining valuable insights into the intricate workings of modern industrial equipment. The journey culminated in the hot moulding section, where they learned about the shaping of plastic canes, a crucial component in oil packaging. The students also explored the packaging section, observing the meticulous processes involved in packaging oil cans and boxes in various sizes, from ½ L to 15 L.

    Students gained practical knowledge about the oil extraction process, witnessed advanced machinery in action, and learned about the intricacies of industrial packaging. This exposure will undoubtedly broaden their horizons and contribute significantly to their academic and professional development.

    LM Bakers Private Limited

    The students of Mechanical Engineering recently had the opportunity to visit LM Bakers Private Limited, a company that manufactures biscuits for Parle, a leading Indian brand. During the industrial visit, the students gained valuable insights into the biscuit production process. They witnessed firsthand the transformation of raw materials into delicious treats, observing how the ingredients move through various ovens and conveyor belts. This visit provided the students with a practical understanding of the mechanical engineering principles applied in a real-world manufacturing setting.

    About the Department

    1361:

    The Master of Computer Applications (MCA) program at Bansal Institute of Science & Technology is a two-year postgraduate degree designed to provide students with strong theoretical knowledge and practical skills in the field of computer applications.

    The program has been running successfully since 2020 and is affiliated with Rajiv Gandhi Proudyogiki Vishwavidyalaya (RGPV), Bhopal. It is also approved by AICTE (All India Council for Technical Education), ensuring that the curriculum meets national standards of technical education.

    The institute is NAAC Accredited, reflecting its commitment to maintaining high academic quality and institutional excellence.

    Program Duration: 2 Years (4 Semesters)

    The MCA program aims to prepare students for successful careers in the IT industry by developing expertise in software development, programming, database management, and emerging technologies.

    Overview

    1972:

    MCA course at Bansal Group of Institute was started in the year 2000 with the aim to provide quality technical education to Software industry aspirants and to create world-class software professionals.

    At BIST we focus on providing a sound theoretical background as well as good practical exposure to students in the relevant areas. It is intended to provide a modern, industry-oriented education in computer science and Applications. It aims at producing trained professionals who can successfully meet the demands of the IT industry.

    Students are trained in the fields of Computer Networks, Information Storage and Management,  System Administration, Web Designing and Development, Database Administration, Cloud Computing, Data Mining and Warehousing, Application Software Development, Enterprise Resource Planning, etc.

    Real-Time Training Students are sent to various reputed companies in the IT industry to spend a full semester working at the institute giving them insight into the workings of the IT world and making them familiar with the working environment of the industry and to undertake live projects.

    Placements Students at BIST are provided opportunities to appear in the campus selection process of all the reputed companies like TCS, Cognizant, Infosys, and Tech-Mahindra are a few to mention and selected at handsome packages also.
